name: kautian-extension
description: Make searching the kautian website easier.

scripts.build: npm run build:data && npm run build:js
scripts.package: npm run build && rm -f kautian-extension.zip && zip -q kautian-extension.zip manifest.json background.js icons/icon16.png icons/icon32.png icons/icon48.png icons/icon128.png dist/content.js dist/content.css data/kautian.min.json options/options.html options/options.css options/options.js && ls -la kautian-extension.zip
